clean_story:
Now I will teach you Clouds. Look up at the sky when the sun is not too bright. Sometimes, you see big, soft, white things floating high, like smoke but not from fire. They move slowly, like leaves on the river. They can be thin like mist or thick like fur. When they cover the sun, the land gets dark. This is Clouds.

Discover rain, wind, and sky.
